description: Open a provisional Forbiz workspace with no account, no email and no human (POST /bootstrap). The credential is stored locally by this server and never shown. Returns the workspace, the trial limits and a claim link for the owner. Call it once; if a credential already exists it refuses unless replace is true.

agent_name.description: Your name as an agent, e.g. 'Acme ops agent'

replace.description: Open a new workspace even if a credential is already stored

workspace_name.description: Name of the business or workspace

name: forbiz_start
title: Open a Forbiz workspace
